# ADR-3110: A10: Raw HTTP redirect follow for webhook 2

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Redirects pivot SSRF into unexpected networks.

## Decision

HTTP clients MUST NOT enable a raw HTTP redirect follow for webhook 2 (A10-2).

## Consequences

Redirects are disabled or re-validated.
